polityNote: Republic of Haiti. The ten departments from the creation of Nippes (2003-09-04). The nine-department layout of the 1962 law is not claimed: statoids says it was implemented only "around 1980", so no day or year can be stated for its start (Grand'Anse before 2003 would be the union of the Grand'Anse and Nippes atoms).

sources.title: Statoids — Departments of Haiti (change history)
sources.says: Five departments became nine by a 1962 law implemented only around 1980; Nippes split from Grand'Anse on 2003-09-04 (Miragoâne, Anse-à-Veau and new Baradères arrondissements); no later change listed.

sources.title: Wikipedia (fr) — Départements d'Haïti (oldid 236656601)
sources.says: Ten departments under Title V section D of the 1987 Constitution; Nippes created in 2003.
